name: Winifred D. Land
original_name: ウィナフレッド・D・ランド
source:
A ghost girl who appears in the Princess Area.
She doesn't know where she came from or why she can't pass on to the afterlife, but she doesn't let any of that bother her, spending her days carefree and happily. She is a natural airhead.

Because she is invisible to normal people and, for some reason, only Kazumi can see her, she frequently appears and happily clings to him.

She apparently was a princess who lived in an old castle relocated from a foreign country long ago, but……
